sections.h2: Horse Country, three towns, one crew
body: Marion County is pastureland, springs, and quickly growing neighborhoods. Ocala is one of our two largest markets, and Dunnellon and Belleview round out the area we cover. As a painting contractor in Marion County FL, we bring the same crews, the same written estimate, and the same premium Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore products to a downtown cottage as to a sprawling estate.
Each kind of property here has its own failure pattern and its own prep plan:
bullets: Equestrian estates: large wall areas and wood under direct sun, where scope is often split across several elevations and phases
Brick-street historic homes: layered old paint on wood trim and porches that calls for careful scraping and spot-priming
Mid-century ranches: block and stucco with hairline cracking, a fit for elastomeric coatings
New construction: thin builder-grade paint that chalks early and benefits from a proper two-coat repaint
River and springs homes: year-round humidity that makes mildew treatment and moisture readings essential

sections.h2: Towns we serve in Marion County
body: Ocala is the heart of Horse Country, with brick-streeted historic districts, mid-century neighborhoods, and estates spread across SW and NW Ocala. See our Ocala painters page and the full list of Ocala painting services.
Dunnellon sits on two rivers near Rainbow Springs, with a downtown of historic Florida Cracker homes that live with humidity all year. Visit painting in Dunnellon and Dunnellon services.
Belleview includes Lake Lillian, its downtown, and a band of mid-century and new residential growth between Ocala and The Villages. See Belleview painting and services in Belleview.

sections.h2: What Marion County owners usually ask for
body: Exterior repainting is the backbone of our Marion County work, since sun and humidity are hard on everything outside. Deck and fence staining, pressure washing, and stucco repair follow close behind. Inside, cabinet refinishing and whole-home interiors are common in the established Ocala neighborhoods, and commercial clients call on us for offices, retail, and multi-family repaints scheduled after hours. Our article on restoring sun-damaged paint in Ocala covers the most common exterior issue.

sections.h2: Questions to settle before an estate or HOA repaint
body: Larger Marion County projects go smoother when a few decisions are made up front. Which structures and elevations are in scope this year? Is there an HOA color list or approval step? Do horses, livestock, or residents need certain areas kept clear on certain days? Are there gates, long drives, or tall walls that affect access and equipment?

We write the answers into the estimate. Surfaces included and excluded, product lines, coat counts, and the working schedule are all on paper, and for HOA or property-management clients a certificate of insurance naming the entity is available before we mobilize. See our page on HOA and property management painting for more.

sections.h2: How scheduling works south of our home base
body: We plan Marion County jobs so prep and painting run on consecutive days rather than being spread thin. Walkthroughs are typically set within 48 hours, the written quote arrives within one business day, and most projects begin one to three weeks after you approve. A full exterior generally takes three to seven working days plus wash and dry time, and October through May is the preferred exterior season.

faqs.q: Can you phase a large estate repaint over time?
faqs.a: Yes. Because the estimate is itemized by area, you can approve one structure or elevation now and schedule the rest later.

faqs.q: Do you work in Dunnellon and Belleview, or only Ocala?
faqs.a: We serve all three: Ocala, Dunnellon, and Belleview, along with the rural roads between them.

faqs.q: What coating do you use on block-and-stucco ranches?
faqs.a: Stucco with hairline movement gets an elastomeric coating that bridges small cracks; trim and siding get premium 100% acrylic.
